main_body: Beehive-shaped thatched hut: a large conical straw roof dome over a short clay-brick wall with an arched, recessed doorway
top_band: Thatch roof from row 1 to about row 56, lightest straw yellow at the crown and ringed by darker course lines. It reads as a sloped top surface seen from above and ends in a dark eave line at rows 55-57.
evidence: In the middle column the roof dome (rows 1-56) has a hat-like silhouette with overhanging eaves. A dark eave shadow at rows 55-58 separates it from the brown wall face (rows 58-77), which has its own shading and brick dashes. The arched door has a dark inner opening, a lintel and posts, so it reads as inset. A stone plinth sits at the base. The roof is the top surface and the wall is the front face, so both are clearly drawn. No isometric side face.

style.evidence: The thatch has about 5 steps (pale straw, light, mid, dark, deep brown) with course lines and per-bundle dashes, so it is textured like the reference roofs. The outline is dark brown, tinted to the neighbouring material, not black. The wall has about 4 tones, brick dashes and a stone-grain plinth. The wall is slightly smoother than the reference wall and some wall patches are fairly plain, but there are no large flat fills. Overall it sits acceptably next to the references.
